name: eBay used NVIDIA Tesla P100 16GB PCIe card
price_basis: USED, bare passive PCIe card. $115 = midpoint of the $89.95-143.85 ask band for the PCIe version captured 2026-10-03..14 (SXM2 module ~$175 needs a carrier). ASKING price, not sold. PERISHABLE-FIGURE STAMP: OBSERVED 2026-10-14. RE-VERIFY BY: 2027-01-14.
lead_time_basis: lead_time_weeks is null because this is a secondary market priced per listing.
export_control_note: Pascal-generation part below the advanced-computing thresholds; general EAR applies.
notes: Bandwidth per dollar is great (732 GB/s HBM2 - roughly 2x the P40's 347 per GB) but CAPACITY ISN'T: 16 GB caps you at ~13B Q4. PCIe version is passive (needs airflow); SXM2 variant needs a carrier. No DP4A -> Q4_0/Q8 GGUF only; no FP16 tensor. CC6.0 FP16 is 2x FP32 on paper but the GGUF path is what matters. Bandwidth implies ~2x P40 decode ceiling; no direct llama.cpp measurement was captured.
